observations: Inspected all24 original/enhanced context pages, all286 metric-failing pair types. Native placement discontinuities are visible in each original example; enhanced layouts retain their locations and material identities.

Cases include road openings terminating in plain soil, reversed/misaligned grass and rock corners, isolated transition tiles inside uniform masters, mismatched sand corners, and clipped water/lava/tar fringes.

Current voltylx removes the previously introduced dirt frame. Its remaining encounter with volxsw is a native mixed-edge placement. The one newly failing metric type volxse S voltyl also has the corner discontinuity in original art.
No additional texture repair is warranted by these specific failures. Do not alter correct shared textures to hide a map-specific incompatible placement.
Scope: phase0 offline map-layout triage at3x3 context, one retained example per unique pair; numerical all-phase compatible checks and native camera/animation/movement review are separate gates.
